text_suite.note: The 170 does not exist until step 4; its hash is added there. Both freezes appear on every result.

text_provider.note: Sarvam 105B text-to-text drops in as one config value when the key lands. Verified 2026-08-21: the Voice Agents key returns 403 invalid_api_key_error on https://api.sarvam.ai/v1/chat/completions, so a separate API subscription key is required. The provider must not change between the BASE and IMPROVED passes.

rules.validity: A session counts only if evaluator-valid AND transport-healthy. An unreachable tool endpoint yields tool_transport_invalid and the record is excluded, never scored as agent failure.

tool_requirement_by_tier.text: Explicit record_call_outcome with the exact outcome, plus any business write. Verified in-process.
tool_requirement_by_tier.live: Correct extracted disposition AND, where the card requires it, a journal-verified HTTP tool effect. Reported as two numbers, never merged.

rules.headline: Blind split only (86). Development scores are shown and labelled in-sample, and never lead.
rules.live_metric: Report the pair: claims_made and claims_grounded, plus required-effect completion independently. A single grounded ratio hides an agent that stopped claiming and stopped writing.
rules.synthetic_data: Generated scenarios enter the development split only, tagged synthetic. Blind splits and the sealed final stay human-authored.
rules.families: The 14-family taxonomy is fixed in advance. The manifest records which families were pre-specified and which were discovered in steps 2-3.
rules.decision: Text: blind-split paired win with zero severe regressions. Voice: grounded-claim pair and required-effect completion on identical records. Recorded human tier: descriptive only, n too small to gate.
rules.ordering: transport -> tools -> platform proof -> commit -> measurement. No paid call without a same-day platform-originated journal line.
rules.versions: Two agent versions only: BASE and IMPROVED.

budget.fallback: If the balance does not cover 15+15, drop to N=10 or N=8 matched. Never a half-run arm.
budget.text_tier: First five episodes price the model before the rest run.

claim_boundary: Nothing in this campaign has been measured yet. Every figure is produced after this manifest was frozen.
